effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your hand has 7 or fewer cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
